text: Passing calShowUnifinder as the second goToggleToolbar target makes the splitter toggle update that menu item’s checked attribute to the inverse hidden state and persist it. The bottom-events-box toggle still targets the Calendar command separately. The menu item dispatches that command to toggleUnifinder. This is the direct comm helper/control path, not a rendered menu or native accessibility result.
title: The Unifinder splitter toggle writes the concrete menu checkbox state
